# relay_ip_access_list (Resource)

One entry of a workspace's IP access list: a source range allowed to reach the public endpoints of every database in the workspace. Creating, updating and destroying wait until the change has reached the edge. Private endpoints are not subject to the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_ip_access_list" "office" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  cidr         = "203.0.113.0/24"
  description  = "Office VPN"
}

resource "relay_ip_access_list" "ci" {
  for_each = toset(["198.51.100.7/32", "198.51.100.8/32"])

  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  cidr         = each.value
  description  = "CI runner"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 network in canonical form, unique in the workspace. A single host is `/32` or `/128`. Changing it updates the entry in place.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the entry belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text label, up to 200 characters.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `created_by` (String) Principal that added the entry.
- `id` (String) Entry ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_ip_access_list.office <workspace_id>/<cidr>
```
